name: Scapular Retraction Hold

instructions.description: Stand or sit holding a light resistance band with elbows by your sides.
Draw the shoulders gently back and down while pulling the band apart a small amount.
Hold the position without shrugging or lifting the chest excessively.
Release slowly and reset before the next repetition.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use short holds with precise scapular positioning.

variations.variationDescription: An isometric posture-focused variation of the horizontal band pull.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Practice the same shoulder position without band resistance.

commentsNotes: The movement is subtle, not forceful.
Avoid pinching the shoulder blades too hard.
